slot_scores.name: sequential_machine_order_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When you say the order of processing the three
slot_scores.rationale: The agent attempted to probe the order/sequence requirement, but every relevant question (turns 2-30) is a truncated, incomplete fragment and never clearly asks whether each product must follow a fixed machine sequence (1->2->3). It touches the related ordering issue without covering the slot's key meaning.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_processing_cycle
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the specific objective you want to optimize, such as minimizing the total completion time of all three products or minimizing the makespan
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asks for the objective and offers makespan as a candidate, matching the reference question about whether the objective is makespan or something else.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation degenerates into repeated truncated/incomplete questions (turns 2-30) and ends without any READY_TO_MODEL or equivalent final modeling/answer state, so no clean stop occurred. H1 (P0) remained unresolved; only H2 was addressed.

summary: The agent asked one valid objective-clarification question but then fell into a long loop of incomplete, truncated questions, never fully resolving the machine-sequence constraint (H1) and never reaching a modeling or final-answer state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
